english_translations.sahih_international: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.
english_translations.pickthall: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: That Day will be the sure Reality: Therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) return to his Lord!
english_translations.shakir: That is the sure day, so whoever desires may take refuge with his Lord.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: That will be the Day of the Truth. So let those who want seek refuge from their Lord.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: That is without doubt the True Day, so, whosoever wills, let him seek a place with (or a way to) His Lord (by obeying Him in this worldly life)!
english_translations.arberry: That is the true day; so whosoever wills takes unto his Lord a resort.

ayahs.transliteration: innā andharnākum ʿadhāban qarīban yawma yanẓuru l-maru mā qaddamat yadāhu wayaqūlu l-kāfiru yālaytanī kuntu turāban
ayahs.translation_bn: আমি তোমাদেরকে নিকটবর্তী শাস্তি সম্পর্কে সতর্ক করছি, যেদিন মানুষ দেখতে পাবে তার হাতগুলো আগেই কী (‘আমাল) পাঠিয়েছে আর কাফির বলবে- ‘হায়! আমি যদি মাটি হতাম (তাহলে আমাকে আজকের এ ‘আযাবের সম্মুখীন হতে হত না)।
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
ayahs.conventional_en: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
ayahs.conventional_bn: আমি তোমাদেরকে নিকটবর্তী শাস্তি সম্পর্কে সতর্ক করছি, যেদিন মানুষ দেখতে পাবে তার হাতগুলো আগেই কী (‘আমাল) পাঠিয়েছে আর কাফির বলবে- ‘হায়! আমি যদি মাটি হতাম (তাহলে আমাকে আজকের এ ‘আযাবের সম্মুখীন হতে হত না)।

ayahs.meta_en: The Immediate Horizon: Foreseeing Personal Handiwork and Wishing for Total Dissolution

english_translations.sahih_international: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
english_translations.pickthall: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust!"
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Verily, We have warned you of a Penalty near, the Day when man will see (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the Unbeliever will say, "Woe unto me! Would that I were (metre) dust!"
english_translations.shakir: Surely We have warned you of a chastisement near at hand: the day when man shall see what his two hands have sent before, and the unbeliever shall say: O! would that I were dust!
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: We have warned you of the approaching torment. On that day, a person will see what his hands have committed. A disbeliever will say, "Would that I had been dust".
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Verily, We have warned you of a near torment, the Day when man will see that (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the disbeliever will say: "Woe to me! Would that I were dust!"
english_translations.arberry: Lo, We have warned you of a nigh chastisement, upon the day when a man shall behold what his hands have forwarded, and the unbeliever shall say, 'O would that I were dust!'
